drops.title: Leopard Pelt
drops.brief: Leopard pelt up close — a rich golden-tawny coat packed edge to edge with jet-black broken-ring rosettes around burnt-orange centres and small solid black spots, the coat paling to a cream-white belly toward the rockers and lower fascia; world-metre 3D paint so every rosette stays round on the hood and runs unbroken over the hood-to-fascia crease, door seams, roof and tail; dense coverage, regenerated impression, no logos.

drops.title: Drone Show
drops.brief: Night drone show eve — a deep midnight-indigo sky body packed edge to edge with a hovering swarm of glowing drone lights in ice-white, electric cyan, hot magenta, and a few amber, each a hot pinpoint core with a soft halo, colour-shifting in broad sweeps across the car; on each flank and the hood the swarm tightens into one big plain crossed-strokes X made of white-hot drones, with faint long-exposure flight-trail arcs and a sparse pinprick starfield behind; world-metre 3D paint so the swarm runs unbroken over the hood-to-fascia crease, door seams, roof, and tail; dense coverage, regenerated impression, no logos, no event names, no Tesla marks.

drops.title: Brain Coral
drops.brief: Brain coral up close: one unbroken labyrinth of acid-lime meandering ridges with pale crest highlights and embossed relief shading, winding through deep plum-black furrows like a living maze; isotropic world-metre 3D field so every ridge runs unbroken over the hood-to-fascia crease, door seams, roof, and tail with no stretch on the hood; dense full-body coverage, regenerated impression, no logos.

drops.title: Koi Pond
drops.brief: Koi pond from above — a deep lacquer ink-blue water body crowded with swimming koi in vermilion-and-snow, sumi-spotted tri-colour, solid gold, and black-red patterns, each with a soft drop shadow, drifting in every direction between jade lily pads and faint concentric ripple rings; world-metre 3D paint so fish and pads cross the hood-to-fascia crease, door seams, and tail in one piece; dense coverage, regenerated impression, no logos.

drops.title: Action Drip
drops.brief: Studio action painting — a raw gallery-white canvas body flung with long looping skeins of jet-black enamel, overlaid with thinner cobalt, cadmium-red, and chrome-yellow pours, peppered with spatter and splat crowns, and on the upright panels a few gravity drips running straight down toward the rockers; world-metre 3D paint so every skein crosses the hood-to-fascia crease, door seams, and tail in one piece; regenerated studio impression, no artist style marks, no logos.

drops.title: Fractal Burn
drops.brief: Lichtenberg pyrography — pale blonde maple body with soft horizontal grain, scorched by branching fractal char-black burn trees with thin glowing ember-orange edges, rooted low on the rockers and fascias and climbing toward the roof; world-metre 3D bake so the burns cross every crease; regenerated woodshop impression, no logos.

drops.title: Piano Key
drops.brief: Piano keyboard — ivory-cream and ebony-black keys marching nose to tail with thin charcoal gaps, shorter floating black keys, continuous plane-metric wrap.

drops.title: Marquee Bulb
drops.brief: Theater marquee — deep ink-black body studded with staggered rows of warm tungsten glass bulbs in thin chrome bezels marching nose to tail, sparse cool-white spare bulbs; plane world-bake continuous wrap, regenerated print-shop impression, no logos.

drops.title: Canopy Dapple
drops.brief: Forest canopy sun-dapple — hot pale-gold sunflecks with chartreuse rims pooling through moss and teal leaf shadow over near-black shade, with rare sky-gap flecks; plane world-bake continuous wrap, regenerated outdoors impression, no logos.

drops.title: Film Sprocket
drops.brief: Celluloid film strip — warm amber-sepia emulsion frames marching nose to tail over charcoal leader, dual cream sprocket-perforation rails at roof-edge and rocker, sparse cyan frame flashes; plane world-bake continuous wrap, regenerated print-shop impression, no logos.

drops.title: Basalt Column
drops.brief: Columnar basalt — tall charcoal-obsidian prismatic columns with pale ash-cream joints and sparse lichen-green mineral flecks; plane world-bake so columns wrap nose to tail; regenerated geology impression, no logos.

drops.title: Stencil Flood
drops.brief: Layered spray-stencil floods — hard-edged overlapping cutouts in tomato red, cobalt, bone, and charcoal over kraft-concrete ground, with soft overspray fringe; plane world-bake so floods wrap nose to tail; regenerated print-shop impression, no logos.

drops.title: Prairie Shear
drops.brief: Wind-sheared tallgrass: amber and wheat blades leaning one way across soil-brown and charcoal ground, with sparse pale seed-head flecks; plane world-bake so the gust wraps nose to tail; regenerated prairie impression, no logos.

drops.title: Heat Tile
drops.brief: Starship Flight 14 launch-eve: brushed stainless upper body over a black hex heat-shield tile band on the rockers, with a thin ice orbit-track hairline. Regenerated Starbase impression — no logos.

drops.title: Tape Block
drops.brief: Tesla Semi–inspired DOT red/white conspicuity-tape blocks on brushed aluminum with a thin Supercharger-orange hairline; plane-metric world-bake; regenerated impression, no logos/seals.

drops.title: Strata Cut
drops.brief: Desert mesa sedimentary strata — bone and terracotta stacked with indigo shale and charcoal bands of irregular height; continuous wrap via plane world-bake; regenerated geology impression, no logos/seals.

drops.title: Deco Flare
drops.brief: Miami Art Dec — deep ink-navy body with stepped chevron / ziggurat bands in coral, cream, aqua, and sparse gold accents; continuous wrap via plane world-bake; regenerated impression, no logos/seals.

drops.title: Circuit Etch
drops.brief: Deep solder-mask green PCB body with copper trace mazes, via pads, and sparse teal silkscreen ticks; continuous wrap via plane world-bake; regenerated circuit-board impression, no logos/seals.

drops.title: Cedar Wake
drops.brief: Seattle pier cedar-shake / plank bands on charcoal with moss green, foam wake chevrons, and salmon accents; continuous wrap via plane world-bake; regenerated outdoors impression, no logos/seals.

drops.title: Halftone
drops.brief: Deep ink-black body overprinted with overlapping cyan, magenta, and yellow circular CMYK-style halftone screens at classic print angles (~15°/75°/0°), high-contrast wrap-around field; continuous wrap via plane world-bake; regenerated print-process impression, no logos/seals.

drops.title: Helix Band
drops.brief: Helical candy-stripe bands wrapping the body — deep charcoal base with alternating hot magenta and acid lime spiral stripes (thin white edge ticks); continuous wrap via plane world-bake.

drops.title: Prism Fold
drops.brief: Charcoal origami facet field with ice faces, indigo shadows, and tangerine crease highlights; continuous wrap via plane world-bake.

drops.title: Radar Arc
drops.brief: Deep navy CRT-phosphor body with lime concentric radar rings, one amber sweep wedge, and sparse cyan ping blips; continuous wrap via plane world-bake; regenerated radar/scope impression, no logos/seals.

drops.title: Bar Scan
drops.brief: Warm paper-cream body with irregular-width vertical barcode lanes in deep ink, sparse signal-red guard pairs, and thin lemon laser accents; continuous wrap via plane world-bake; regenerated barcode/scan impression, no logos/seals.

drops.title: Moire Pulse
drops.brief: Deep ink body with overlapping lime and magenta diagonal gratings that interfere into cyan pulse nodes; continuous wrap via plane world-bake; regenerated moiré impression, no logos/seals.

drops.title: Scale Flash
drops.brief: Scale Flash — near-black indigo scute lattice, cyan rim / amber fill.

drops.title: Plaid Zap
drops.brief: Plaid Zap — near-black tartan, magenta / acid yellow / cyan warp-weft.

drops.title: Hex Comb
drops.brief: Hex Comb — charcoal honeycomb lattice, mint and coral cell walls.

drops.title: Topo Ink
drops.brief: Warm paper-cream body with a high-contrast topographic contour-map field — nested closed ink contours from a continuous vehicle-space height field, charcoal major/minor contour lines plus occasional cadmium index contours wrapping every panel continuously; regenerated map impression, no logos/seals.

drops.title: Argyle Cut
drops.brief: Ivory body with a high-contrast argyle diamond lattice in crimson and navy that tiles continuously in vehicle space (u=nose→tail, v=roof→rocker) — intersecting 45° diamonds wrapping around every panel, regenerated impression, no logos.

drops.title: Terrazzo Pop
drops.brief: Warm parchment body densely speckled with multi-color terrazzo chips (coral, teal, mustard, indigo, charcoal) — irregular chips of varying size that feel continuous across door seams via shared (u,v) noise; high-contrast graphic stone, regenerated impression, no logos.

drops.title: Slash Field
drops.brief: Bone-cream body scored by bold vermillion and charcoal diagonal slash bands (~35° in vehicle space) that wrap continuously around every panel — high-contrast graphic cut fields, regenerated impression, no logos.

drops.title: Bayou Dusk
drops.brief: Deep bayou teal-black body with coral-orange Gulf sunset ribbons flowing continuous nose→tail across door seams, and cool silver downtown light-grid streams cascading from roof toward rockers — Space City night energy, high contrast for touchscreen; regenerated impression, no logos.

drops.title: Volt Rail
drops.brief: Graphite-black body with electric lime and cyan continuous power-rail streams running nose→tail, hot-white edge sparks cascading from the roof downhill — high contrast for the touchscreen; regenerated impression, no logos.

drops.title: Chi Lake
drops.brief: Chicago lakefront night: Michigan teal and midnight navy cascading from the roof, with amber L-train window sparks and soft skyline reflections drifting downhill — continuous UV remaster so sides flow fender→doors→quarter (Cybertruck unchanged). Regenerated impression, no logos.

drops.title: Reef Flash
drops.brief: Abyssal navy with electric turquoise and hot-magenta reef-scale flashes cascading from the roof downhill toward hood, rockers, and tail — animal-as-texture, high contrast for the touchscreen.

drops.title: La Dusk
drops.brief: Los Angeles dusk impression: coral-magenta sun disk on the roof bleeding into indigo night toward the rockers, with soft palm-frond silhouettes and thin freeway light ribbons drifting downhill — regenerated, no logos.

drops.title: Norther
drops.brief: Texas blue norther: ice-white rime on deep navy, heavier at the roof and blowing out toward hood, rockers, and tail.

drops.title: Robotaxi
drops.brief: Glossy champagne-gold Cybercab paint with original ROBOTAXI lettering on the doors, hood, and tailgate for the September 3 2026 Austin launch.

drops.title: Taxi Steam
drops.brief: Wet-asphalt night wrap with taxi-yellow lane stripes and steam veils rising from a subway-tile roof, skyline silhouettes as texture running downhill toward hood, rockers, and tailgate.

drops.title: Ion Bloom
drops.brief: Ink-black bodywork blooming high-contrast ion-violet flowers from the roof, each petal edged in electric-cyan that cascades downhill toward hood, rockers, and tailgate.

drops.title: Magma Rift
drops.brief: Charcoal basalt split by high-contrast molten-gold magma rifts that originate on the roof and flow downhill toward rockers, hood, and tailgate.

drops.title: ember-cascade
drops.brief: Ember cascade: warm fire-scale cascade (sister-line accidental drop).

drops.title: laser-vein
drops.brief: High-contrast laser-vein network in electric cyan and hot magenta originating at the roof center and flowing outward under gravity.

drops.title: neon-cascade
drops.brief: High-contrast neon cyan-to-magenta liquid cascades dripping from the vehicle crown (UV center), flowing downhill across every panel.

drops.title: neon-vortex
drops.brief: Deep-space black pierced by neon-cyan and magenta energy vortex centered on the roof, plasma trails cascading downhill.

drops.title: plasma-veil
drops.brief: Deep-space violet body with high-contrast cyan-to-magenta plasma ribbons that birth at the roof/hood high points and cascade outward under gravity toward hood, rockers and tail.

drops.title: plasma-vein
drops.brief: Deep void-black panels laced with electric-cyan and magenta plasma veins originating at the roof center and flowing downhill.

drops.title: robotaxi
drops.brief: Glossy champagne-gold Cybercab molded paint. No side lettering, matching production Cybercab.
